title: Show Resolved DBs (debug)
summary: Prints which database(s) drag-lint would actually use for a given project, file, or platform, without running a real query

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Index & Maintenance > Show Resolved DBs (debug)...

surfaces.usage: drag-lint resolve-dbs [--platform win32|win64] [--config <path>] [--json] (print the consumer DB list query/lsp/serve would use)
help: drag-lint resolve-dbs [--platform win32|win64] [--config <path>] [--json]   (print the consumer DB list query/lsp/serve would use)
drag-lint resolve-dbs --project <file.dproj> [--config <path>] [--json]     (print the ONE db that owns this project -- the WRITE target)
exits 2 and names the sections when none or SEVERAL claim the project,
rather than guessing: `index --rebuild` against a wrongly-picked db
clears an index that was never meant to be touched.
the READ list (what hover / Find Usages / the LSP would open for that
file): the ACTIVE PROJECT's db first, then the folder-matched db.
Omit --project to model "no project active". Same resolution the IDE
uses, so this is how it is verified without an IDE.
No covering index: stdout empty ([] with --json), exit 0, a NOTE on stderr.

pitfalls: never guess a DB path. Also --project `<P.dproj>` and --platform `<win32|win64>`.
